title: Fraudulent trial and dark practice of burying subscription management
body: ⚠️ Be careful — you’ll be pushed to sign up on their website before you even download the app, so this isn’t billed through Apple at all. That means Apple’s own subscription management (Settings → Subscriptions) won’t show it or cancel it. Once you’re subscribed, cancellation is buried behind multiple menus, and the final step throws a generic “error, please try again” every single time — dozens of attempts, identical result. Their in-app “Contact Us” page is also dead (404). If you’re in India, this matches the CCPA’s officially banned ‘subscription trap’ dark pattern. Don’t hand over payment details until this is fixed — and if you’re already in, cancel the underlying payment method (UPI mandate / card) directly rather than trusting their cancel button.

title: I know this app is going to change my life
body:
I have been using the app for 3 days and I’ve already made some positive changes in my life. I’ve started making my bed in the morning, drinking a glass of water, today I stretched a little to too. In the evening, I stop exposure to blue light 90 minutes before bed and instead, read, journal, and meditate as a part of my night routine. The app does enough to keep you motivated. It’s interactive and knows how human behaviour works. It knows not to overwhelm the user, but at the same time, inspire them to stay committed to a routine. The developers did a FABULOUS job at creating a habit tracking app that knows the weakness of a human, and helps them overcome those weakness to cultivate healthy and sustainable habits to create a better life. I’m so happy that I got the premium subscription of this amazing app. I would 100% recommend it to anyone who want to embrace a more disciplined lifestyle. 

Thank you, Fabulous team! ✨

title: Excellent app
body:
I have made Fabulous part of my life this past week and take the annual subscription.
It’s a ‘fabulous’ journey of self improvement and the establishing of routines and habits that I have embarked upon and I sense that the app is so circumspect that I in fact love the structure it give. It Gently nudges me, never in my face, but just steering my days and reminding me while it inspires me to get the things done I am not so eager to do and that are so needful. It’s exactly what I need and I am very grateful to the designers of this app for the obvious research that has gone into coaching me.
I gladly pay for such quality.
